segments.segment_summary: A high-angle shot shows a large group of baby chicks in a brooder with wood shavings. They are gathered in the center, pecking at the ground.

key_moments.caption: A high-angle shot captures dozens of yellow baby chicks on a bed of wood shavings.
A dense cluster of chicks gathers in the center, pecking at something on the ground.
Chicks are seen walking around the periphery of the main group.

segments.segment_summary: A man kneels inside the chicken brooder, surrounded by chicks. He discusses the upcoming cold, wet weather and how it might affect the young chickens.

key_moments.caption: A man wearing a plaid shirt and cap appears, surrounded by chicks in a wooden brooder.
The man explains his concern about a cold, wet front moving in and its effect on the chicks.
He talks about the challenges of pastured poultry farming compared to barn systems.

segments.segment_summary: A close-up shot focuses on a group of chicks gathered around a white waterer and a metal feeder. They are actively eating and drinking from the equipment.

key_moments.caption: A close-up shows chicks gathered around a white waterer, drinking from its red base.
A chick flaps its small wings while standing near the waterer.
More chicks are seen eating from a long, metal feeder in the background.
The man's narration continues, explaining how colder weather will affect the chicks' eating habits and growth.
